Paragraph: Summary of Passage: Krishna reveals the threefold purpose of His divine incarnation: protecting the virtuous, vanquishing destructive forces, and re-establishing righteous principles age after age.
Situation/Problem_Faced: Protecting the good and resolving systemic corruption and harm in society.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Krishna outlines His mission: 'paritranaya sadhunam vinasaya ca duskrtam, dharma-samsthapanarthaya sambhavami yuge yuge' (To protect the righteous, eliminate evil-doers, and re-establish dharma, I appear age after age).
Outcome/Resolution: Reassures seekers that truth, goodness, and justice are ultimately protected by divine intervention.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Protection of the Virtuous: Safeguarding positive values and healthy individuals from harm
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Elimination of Harmful Influences: Removing destructive habits or toxic dynamics
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Re-establishing Stability: Setting strong boundaries to restore long-term psychological health

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Paritranaya sadhunam (For the deliverance of the virtuous)
Vinasaya ca duskrtam (For the destruction of evil-doers)
Dharma-samsthapanarthaya (For the firm re-establishment of righteousness)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Divine incarnations occur periodically to protect spiritual practitioners, eliminate negative forces, and firmly re-establish eternal principles of righteousness.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Actively protecting your core values and removing negative influences is essential for maintaining psychological well-being and growth.
